summary: Frontend-only test of the restyled menus (Shop, Tackle Box, Fishdex, Travel Map, Profile, plus Quests/Market/Leaderboards/Achievements from the More menu) on desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844, logged in as TestAngler. Core flows work: shop tabs, gear cards with art, buying the T2 rod (card shows Equipped), buying bait (owned count and badge go 9 -> 14), info dialogs, keepnet tile toggle, list dialog, selling, re-equipping in the Tackle tab, Fishdex filters/search/species modal, travel and fish-here (both close the modal and open water mode), profile hero, all legacy pages, and close returning to /game. No JS page errors. Found and FIXED one critical mobile bug: the Journal and Profile modals were 980px and 566px wide on a 390px phone, which pushed the close button off-screen. Still open: missing art (broken images) in several legacy panels, and Escape on a nested dialog closes the whole menu.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent. Fishdex and Profile modals overflowed sideways on 390px (panel 980px/566px wide, close button at x=969/555). Cause: the overlay was a grid with an auto track, so the min-content width of the wide water-chip strip (1552px scrollWidth) and the nowrap profile hero text stretched the track. Fix: added grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)] to the overlay div. Now every page modal is 390px with the close button visible; desktop is still 980px.

Pressing Escape while RodInfoDialog (Shop/Tackle) or SpeciesModal (Fishdex) is open closes the WHOLE page-modal and goes to /game, not just the inner dialog. Modal.js listens for keydown on window without checking for nested dialogs or stopping propagation.
Every avatar image is broken: /art/avatars/av_*.jpg is missing from public/art (the folder does not exist), so broken-image icons show on every row.
All 104 badge icons are broken: /art/badges/*.png does not exist and broken-image boxes are shown.
/art/leviathans/*.webp and /art/bosses/*.webp do not exist, so the BossPlate images are broken (no onError fallback). Halloween.js also uses /art/bosses/1099.webp.
crate_bronze/silver/gold.webp are missing from /art/gear (Crates.js has no fallback). scrap.webp and seal.webp are also missing; GearIcon hides those, so the impact is small.

critical_code_review_comments: Modal.js: the Escape listener is global with no stack awareness. Nested dialogs (RodInfoDialog, SpeciesModal, BaitInfoDialog, ListDialog) close the parent modal too
Inventory.js ListDialog uses a fixed inset-0 overlay. It works, but inside the page-modal both overlays stack and Escape closes everything
Inventory.js tackle-card uses /art/gear/<id>.webp with no onError fallback (Slot has one), so any gear id added later without art will show a broken image
Shop.js: 'const narrow = false' is dead code

rca of the issue: Mobile overflow: the page-modal overlay is a CSS grid with an implicit auto column. A grid item's min-content contribution (the Fishdex .g-chips strip with nowrap chips, and the profile hero) widened the track past the viewport even with w-full. Constraining the track with minmax(0,1fr) lets the inner overflow-x:auto and truncate take effect. Escape bug: Modal adds a window keydown listener and nested dialogs add their own, so both fire on one key press.
